name: 12 crash ball
focus: Straight running to win the gain line

roles.9: Passes flat to 10 from the ruck.
roles.10: Runs at the line, then gives a short pass to 12.
roles.12: Holds depth, then runs a hard, straight line onto 10’s outside shoulder.
roles.13: Stays square as the next option if 12 is held.

frames.cap: Ruck ball. 9 is ready to pass. 12 holds his depth behind 10.
9 passes back to 10, who runs flat at the line. 12 steps in on his outside shoulder.
10 draws his defender, then pops a short pass back to 12, running hard and straight.
12 hits the gap between their 10 and 12 at pace and crosses the gain line.
